biology_side.label: novel biological theorems proved in a proof assistant and accepted as biology
biology_side.fallback_behaviour: With verified:false the page renders the biology side of the desk EMPTY: no numeral, no zero. The papers falling and the empty desk carry the beat. A bald '0' is not shipped on this project's own authority, because prior formal-methods-in-biology work exists (systems-biology model checking, process calculi for biochemistry, formalised phylogenetics) and a flat zero may simply be false.
biology_side.when_facts_md_lands: Set verified:true and copy the exact permissible wording from deck/FACTS.md into value and label. Change nothing else.

attrition.sentence: Roughly nine in ten drug programmes that enter clinical trials never reach approval.
attrition.short: Nine in ten drug programmes never make it.
sources: BIO / Informa / QLS, 2011-2020: 12,728 phase transitions; Phase 1 to approval 7.9%
attrition.trap: The data are about PROGRAMMES and drugs, not individual trials. Never say '90% of clinical trials fail'. The page says 'programmes' and shows the unit on screen.
